classification_rule.quantized: fraction of exact-zero first differences >= 0.10 (within nominal segments); quantization step = 25th percentile of non-zero |diff|
classification_rule.note: thresholds set from inspection of this dataset's empirical difference distributions; not derived from first principles

noise_estimator.rejection_reason: MAD collapses to zero on zero-inflated (quantized) channels when applied to the full difference distribution; restricting to non-zero jumps avoids the collapse but inflates steady-state standardized-innovation SD to 2.25-2.88 (should be ~1) on CADC0890/CADC0894, vs. 0.95-0.98 under the naive estimator

quantization_floor: for quantized channels, step^2/12 (variance of Uniform(-step/2, step/2)) added to observation-noise variance r

hierarchical_shrinkage.method: Efron-Morris-type empirical-Bayes shrinkage on log(r), log(q) across channels
